hero.eyebrow: Accounting and tax help in Aiken
hero.title: Smart answers to *tough challenges*

sections.title: Professional, responsive, *thorough*
body: Our team has been helping clients in the Aiken area for years, and client referrals have fueled our growth. Every client gets close personal and professional attention, backed by the expertise of the whole firm.

Our goal as a trusted advisor is to give you insightful advice, so you can make informed financial decisions. We will answer all of your questions as they affect both your taxes and your finances, and we keep learning so our technical knowledge stays current.

Fill in the online tax organizer

items: A monthly newsletter with tax tips

items.a: Yes. Call (803) 649-9147 and we’ll be happy to offer you a free initial consultation.

items.q: Can you help if I owe the IRS?
items.a: Yes: back taxes, liens, levies, wage garnishment, payment plans, offers in compromise and audit representation.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses?
items.a: Yes: bookkeeping, payroll, QuickBooks and succession planning, for business owners, executives and independent professionals.

items.q: How do I send you my documents?
items.a: Use the secure file-sharing page on our site to send them safely.

before: The big “Schedule a Free Consultation” button on the home page opens a box that says “The requested content cannot be loaded. Please try again later.”
The main menu holds more than 60 links, from “IRS Seizures” to “QuickTuneup”
The Firm Profile page doesn’t name a single person at the firm
On a slow phone connection, the home page takes 9.9 seconds to show anything
Google’s accessibility score is 72 out of 100: ten images without descriptions, and the page doesn’t say what language it’s in
after: Every service on one page, grouped so it’s easy to find
The questions clients actually ask, answered
A free-consultation form and one tap to call
